pins.definition: Items that people wear to cover their bodies.

Things that people wear to cover their bodies.

situation: A man stands in a brightly lit bedroom sorting through a overflowing laundry basket and a packed suitcase on his bed.
subject: a variety of garments laid out on the bed
brief: A neat row of folded shirts, trousers, and sweaters rests across a crisp bedspread, filling the center of the frame with bold colors and varied textures. The wardrobe doors stand open behind, showing empty hangers, while the garments themselves are the brightest and most detailed objects in the room.
prompt: A neat row of folded shirts, trousers, and sweaters rests across a crisp bedspread, filling the center of the frame with bold colors and varied textures. The wardrobe doors stand open behind, showing empty hangers, while the garments themselves are the brightest and most detailed objects in the room. a mid-century travel poster painted in gouache, rich opaque colour, confident simplified forms with real painted texture, strong diagonal composition. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
